title: Sidebar Tree Component
description: Build a custom collapsible sidebar tree component showing Project → Volume → Chapter hierarchy. Read-only navigation first (drag-reorder deferred per D-001). Collapsed by default (L-007).
action: Create desktop/src/components/ProjectSidebar.tsx with tree rendering, expand/collapse, chapter selection, context menu for CRUD. Modify desktop/src/stores/uiSlice.ts to add sidebarExpanded state (default false).

convergence.verification: Sidebar renders project tree, clicking chapter triggers setCurrentChapter, collapsed by default
convergence.definition_of_done: Tree component renders hierarchy, supports expand/collapse nodes, chapter selection, CRUD context menu, integrated into App layout

files.change: New component with tree rendering, node expansion, chapter selection, context menu
Add sidebarExpanded (boolean, default false), toggleSidebar, setSidebarExpanded actions
Add ProjectSidebar to layout, conditional rendering based on sidebarExpanded

implementation: 1. Extend uiSlice.ts: add sidebarExpanded: boolean (default false), toggleSidebar(), setSidebarExpanded(value) to UiSlice interface
2. Create ProjectSidebar.tsx: accept projects, volumes, chapters from ProjectSlice state
3. Implement TreeNode component: renders item with expand/collapse icon, title, click handler
4. Tree structure: Project (root) → Volume (expandable) → Chapter (leaf, clickable)
5. Chapter click: calls setCurrentChapter(chapterId) from ProjectSlice
6. Context menu: right-click shows options (Add Volume, Add Chapter, Rename, Delete)
7. Integrate into App.tsx: add sidebar panel to left of main content area, fixed width 256px, toggle button in toolbar
test: Component tests: renders empty state, renders project with volumes/chapters, expand/collapse works, chapter selection fires action, context menu appears
reference: Existing component patterns in desktop/src/components/ — TailwindCSS, no UI library
rationale: Sidebar provides the primary navigation for multi-document workspace, prerequisite for user-facing project management
risks: Custom tree component is significant UI work — phased approach (read-only first) reduces scope
